patches.name: Auto skip intro and recap
patches.description: Automatically skips the intro, recap and song segments as soon as the 'Skip' button would appear, without waiting for a tap.

patches.name: Auto-skip Up Next
patches.description: Plays the next episode immediately when the "Up Next" card appears, skipping the auto-play countdown.

patches.name: Bypass PairIP license check
patches.description: No-ops com.pairip.licensecheck.LicenseClient.checkLicense so the PairIP (Google Play Automatic Integrity Protection) startup license check is skipped and the "Something went wrong / check Google Play" screen is not shown. NOTE: this only bypasses the client-side startup check; FOX's servers may still reject a re-signed app for login/playback.

patches.name: Change app name
patches.description: Changes the app name shown under the launcher icon. Set the desired name in the patch options.

options.title: App name
options.description: The name shown under the app icon.

patches.name: Change app name
patches.description: Changes the app name shown under the launcher icon. Set the desired name in the patch options.

options.title: App name
options.description: The name shown under the app icon.

patches.name: Change package name
patches.description: Changes the app package name so the patched app installs alongside the original. Rewrites provider authorities and custom permissions. Set the desired package name in the patch options. Changing the package name can cause unexpected issues with some app features.

options.title: Package name
options.description: The new application package name (e.g. com.fox.foxone.morphe).

patches.name: Change package name
patches.description: Changes the app package name so the patched app installs alongside the original. Set the desired package name in the patch options. Changing the package name can cause unexpected issues with some app features.

options.title: Package name
options.description: The new application package name (e.g. com.sonyliv.chiggi).

patches.name: Disable AppsFlyer tracking
patches.description: Stops AppsFlyer from initialising and tracking by no-oping the wrapper that calls AppsFlyerLib.start().

patches.name: Disable AppsFlyer tracking
patches.description: Disables AppsFlyer attribution and event tracking. Other SDKs (CleverTap, Firebase Analytics/Crashlytics) are not affected by this patch.

patches.name: Disable Firebase tracking
patches.description: Disables Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics and Performance data collection via manifest flags. Push notifications are unaffected.

patches.name: Disable FoxKit analytics
patches.description: Disables the FoxKit first-party analytics pipeline by no-oping AnalyticsClient.logEvent / logPerformanceEvent, so no analytics events are recorded or uploaded.

patches.name: Disable forced update
patches.description: Disables the forced-update / kill-switch screen by forcing the remote AppUpdateConfig.enabled flag to false.

patches.name: Disable forced update
patches.description: Removes the forced ('immediate') and optional ('flexi') 'update available' popup shown on the home screen.

patches.name: Disable tracking SDKs
patches.description: Stops the Heap analytics and FOX remote-logging SDKs from auto-initialising (disables their startup ContentProviders) and turns off Firebase Analytics/Crashlytics/Performance collection via manifest flags. Push notifications are unaffected.

patches.name: Hide promo banners
patches.description: Hides the CleverTap-driven subscribe/premium promo banners and promo trays on the home screen. Content rows and CleverTap pop-ups/overlays are not affected.

patches.name: Remove video ads
patches.description: Forces PlayerUtil.isAdEnable() to false so the player neither requests nor plays ads. Removes client-side (Google IMA) ads. Server-side stitched ads on some live content (MediaTailor/SSAI) may still appear.

patches.name: Suppress geo / VPN block
patches.description: Stops the dedicated "not available in your region" and "VPN detected" block screens by downgrading the geo/EPD block to a generic error. Geoblocking is enforced server-side by IP, so this does not grant access without a valid in-region IP (e.g. a working India connection).
